name: Bitcoin.org
rootCause: Cobra, the anonymous creator and principal of Bitcoin.org, tweeted that the Bitcoin.org website is being subjected to an "absolutely large-scale" distributed denial of service (DDoS) attack, as well as a Bitcoin ransom demand. Currently Bitcoin.org is accessible.
